title: Koperasi: share profit with the members
description: Sends USDC from the treasury to the Koperasi contract with msg "share". The contract splits it by the voted share rule (reserve back to the DAO, the rest by savings and contribution points); each member then claims their part. Contribution points reset after a share.
summary: Share {{amount}} USDC base units with the Koperasi members

fields.name: amount
fields.label: USDC to share (base units, 6 decimals: 1000000 = 1 USDC)
